title: Vell's personal quest ('The Exile's Ledger') consistently names its destination 'the Keepers' Hall in Hollowbrook' in every quest/status listing all game. The final ending epilogue instead calls the same still-unresolved location 'Barrowmere' ('Vell's ledger stayed unread in Barrowmere... The great mound's door still stands at Barrowmere's edge'). The name is never 'Barrowmere' anywhere else.
